db_verdicts.quote: An easy local data persistence layer, backed by SQLite. ／ Turbosql generates a SQLite schema and prepared queries for each struct: ／ SQLite is an extremely reliable database engine, but it helps to understand how it interfaces with the filesystem. The main `.sqlite` file contains the bulk of the database. During database writes, SQLite also creates `.sqlite-wal` and `.sqlite-shm` files. If the host process is terminated without flushing writes, you may end up with these three files when you expected to have a single file. This is always fine; on next launch, SQLite knows how to resolve any interrupted writes and make sense of the world. However, if the `-wal` and/or `-shm` files are present, they **must be considered essential to database integrity**. Deleting them may result in a corrupted database. See https://sqlite.org/tempfiles.html.

audit.evidence: GraphJin is a compiler and runtime that gives AI agents one governed graph over the systems a real company already has: databases, warehouses, files, source code, workflows, metadata, and security policy. Instead of handing an agent raw credentials and hoping it guesses correctly, GraphJin exposes that graph through GraphQL + MCP: the agent discovers before acting, validates queries, runs approved work, observes runtime status — and every answer is checked against an execution ledger before it leaves the server. ／ It is not only for agents. GraphJin is still a high-performance GraphQL-to-database compiler, Go library, standalone API service, REST/OpenAPI gateway, and real-time subscription server. 支持 DesHttp、AesHttp、Https 多种加密接入方式
HTTPDNS 未查询到解析结果时回退 LocalDNS 解析
use_cases: Android 应用接入腾讯云 HTTPDNS 域名解析服务
targetSdkVersion>=28 应用配置 HTTP 明文白名单
通过 SDK 初始化配置 dnsId 与鉴权信息

classification.eco_why: README 未涉及数据库，为 DNS 解析客户端 SDK，与数据库生态关系不明

audit.evidence: # HTTPDNS SDK Android ／ 将 HttpDnsLibs 目录下的 aar 包拷贝至项目工程中 libs 相应位置 ／ - 使用 SDK 方式接入 HTTPDNS，若 HTTPDNS 未查询到解析结果，则通过 LocalDNS 进行域名解析，返回 LocalDNS 的解析结果。

identity.one_liner: Go 语言实现的区块链教学源码库，配套电子书逐章构建
identity.review: 该仓库是《Build a Blockchain from Scratch in Go》电子书的配套源码，面向想理解区块链内部原理的软件开发者。读者按章节切换 git 分支，用 go install 构建 tbb 节点，实现钱包、挖矿、共识、P2P 同步等组件；README 明确说明代码仅用于教学，不适用于生产环境。
highlights: 每个电子书章节对应一个独立 git 分支供实验
提供 tbb CLI 运行节点、创建钱包账户、连接测试网络
包含单元测试与集成测试，可用 go test 运行
use_cases: 软件开发者学习区块链底层组件实现
按章节对照电子书练习 Go 编程
运行教学测试网络节点验证交易

classification.eco_why: 仓库是区块链教学节点的实现与源码，未提供面向数据库生态的工具或组件

audit.evidence: > The source-code for: "Build a Blockchain from Scratch in Go" eBook. ／ Chapter by chapter, you will build a full peer-to-peer, autonomous training blockchain system in Go and **learn all standard blockchain components!** ／ go install ./cmd/...

identity.one_liner: 以管道传递 Python 值的现代 shell
identity.review: Marcel 是一个用 Python 实现的命令行 shell，操作符之间传递 Python 对象而非字符串，并用 Python 替代传统 shell 脚本语言，提供 marcel.api 模块供 Python 代码内嵌 shell 管道。面向熟悉 Python 的命令行用户，通过 pip 安装。README 未涉及任何数据库功能，主题标签中的 database/postgres 未在正文中体现。
highlights: 管道操作符间传递 Python 内置类型及 File/Process 对象
提供 marcel.api 模块，可在 Python 代码中调用 shell 管道
支持命令历史、Tab 补全、自定义提示符与配色
use_cases: 用 Python 函数替代 awk/find 做文件过滤与处理
在 Python 脚本中嵌入 shell 管道操作
交互式命令行日常操作与脚本编写

了解不同标识符方案的差异
